lines.trans: Look at the beautiful light over Paris.
The fresh air does me good.
You breathe better without that stress.
I leave my old conflicts behind.
It is a new life beginning.
Yes, a new start for us.
We form a real family now.
It is the most beautiful gift possible.
Let us take the time to live well.
It is good to walk with you.
I always stay by your side.
Our future will be much calmer.
Let us enjoy this gentle day together.
Thank you for your precious love.

meanings.note: avoir l'air + adjective = to look, to seem

examples.trans: The future of the agency is secure.
He is thinking about his future.

meanings.note: before the noun; bel before a vowel: un bel endroit

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
un cadeau d'anniversaire = a birthday present
une rue calme = a quiet street
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Elles commencent avec un peu de Botox.
examples.trans: They start with a bit of Botox.

meanings.en: commencer par / avec: to start with

examples.text: Il y a un côté positif.

meanings.note: un côté positif: a bright side

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
On veut les esclaves derrière le château, d'accord?
examples.trans: We want the slaves behind the chateau, okay?

meanings.note: avant mon départ = before I leave

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.text: C'est pour faire plaisir à ma famille.
examples.trans: It's to make my family happy.
I'm the one who trained you!

meanings.note: c'est moi qui t'ai formée = I'm the one who trained you
une note de frais = an expense claim
the whole day as it passes; bonne journée = have a nice day
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Il y a de la lumière.

meanings.note: for machines and plans: ça marche = it works / okay
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
merci beaucoup = thank you very much

examples.text: Ce serait mieux avec un homme.
examples.trans: It would be better with a man.

meanings.note: before the noun; nouvel before a vowel
pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end
c'est pas possible! = I can't believe it!

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

profiter.gloss: to enjoy, to make the most of

meanings.en: profiter de = to enjoy, to make the most of

examples.trans: Thank you for your valuable help.
I'm the one who trained you!

meanings.note: c'est moi qui... = I'm the one who...

examples.text: Ne restez pas là à ne rien faire!
examples.trans: Don't just stay there doing nothing!

meanings.en: rester là à + infinitive = to stay there doing

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

examples.text: Il a beaucoup de stress au travail.
examples.trans: He has a lot of stress at work.

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
tout le temps = all the time
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.
examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

meanings.note: before the noun; vieil before a vowel: un vieil ami
vivre à Paris = to live in Paris
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
